title: 22 Bed West Nashville Rooftop and Pool Table
description:
Welcome to Dolly's House — a West End home with room to spare and Music City charm to match. 23 beds, 3.5 baths, and a private rooftop with skyline views work well for bachelorette weekends, birthdays, and family trips. Shoot pool in the game room, pour a drink at the wet bar, and hit Broadway 2 miles away. Safe, walkable neighborhood near Vanderbilt with easy access to the rest of the city.

The space
Your Property 

This West End home has plenty of room for the whole group and a little Music City charm to match. Inside, you'll find modern decor, accent walls, and a layout built for hanging out together.

The open main floor has a comfortable living area and a full kitchen, with room to move between the hangout spots without feeling cramped.

The game room anchors the home with a pool table and space to gather before a night out or unwind when you get back.

Upstairs, the private rooftop has lounge seating and skyline views — a great spot for sunsets, group photos, or pulling everyone together before heading to Broadway.

Sleeping: 23 Beds / 3.5 Bathrooms 

Bedroom 1- 2 queen, 3 full 

Bedroom 2- 1 queen, 2 full 

Bedroom 3- 1 king 

Bedroom 4- 4 full 

Bonus Room - 4 single, 1 queen, 1 full, 1 single 

Garage - 3 full

Guest access
Guests have full private access to the entire home, all floors, the game room and the private rooftop deck. 

Free on-site parking is included. 

Self check-in via smart lock means you arrive on your schedule — no meet-and-greet required. Luggage drop and Early Check In is welcome for early arrivals and late departures (just message us to coordinate)

Other things to note
Neighborhood

You're staying in the luxurious West End — one of Nashville's most walkable, upscale, and in-demand neighborhoods. It's the sweet spot: close enough to feel the energy of Music City, far enough that you can actually sleep.

Vanderbilt University is right around the corner, giving the area a lively but safe, well-maintained feel with tree-lined streets and beautiful homes. 

Nearby hotspots include:

- Lower Broadway and the Honky-Tonk Highway — 2 miles
- The Gulch (rooftop bars, shopping, dining) — 1.5 miles
- Music Row — about 1.5 miles
- Centennial Park and the Parthenon — walking distance
- Vanderbilt University — walking distance
- West End’s best restaurants and bars — walking distance
